latest_release.name: EffectCraft v0.24.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* .aep import: every loss detail in the prompt; no false shape loss; Orientation expressions (#3365, #3087) by @arnav-hiwarkar in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3448
* ci: run Harden-Runner on every job by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3508
* Updates: take craft-update from craft-libs main at 6e03f65bf by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3511
* Tests: oracle and fixture files go in an exclusively owned temp directory by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3497
* Vector import: split a document at its images in one traversal by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3514
* Variable stroke: first curve approximation scales its tolerance with the path's extent by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3510
* Mask Interpolation: very large shapes skip shape contexts and search coarsely by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3512
* Warp Stabilizer: subspace smoothing visits only the trajectories seen on each frame by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3507
* Logging: continue a message's line breaks on indented lines by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3009
* Lottie import: index precomp sizes and layers, borrow shape groups, bound font names and warnings by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3007
* UI: ScriptUI images decoded within a size limit; effect detection answers each comp once by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/3005
* Project panel: draw vector footage thumbnails at the thumbnail's size by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2998
* Shortcuts: list each binding once and cap the conflict list by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2997
* Engine: name allocators resume each base's suffix instead of retrying from the start by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2996
* Automation: a confined batch can't take a step's params from a reference, and renders refuse folders with outward links by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2930
* Interchange: export ends on folder and precomp cycles; import finds each clip's transitions without scanning the track by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2932
* Puppet: clamp an imported Expansion before padding the outline grid by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2940
* Roto Brush, Object Matte: decode frozen mattes only at the layer's full-resolution grid by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2941
* Simulations: cap the steps a layer time can ask for and bound checkpoints as they are made by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2942
* SVG: bound tessellation, kept geometry, attributes, entity expansion and re-rendering by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2986
* PSD: bounded zip errors, budgeted prediction row, row-bounded PackBits, channel checks before the result by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2987
* Box blur: count repeated edge pixels instead of visiting them by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2990
* Tracking: bounded crop size, Roto chain span and resection copies by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2989
* EPS: bound copies, storage, text outlines, group nesting and font discovery by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2953
* Project: layer name suffixes in one pass; template names bounded and never a parent folder by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/pull/2973
* Text: run lookup by bisection, bounded path flattening, font folders and files shared by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storyt

detail.readme:
EffectCraft

Motion graphics and visual effects; an open-source, professional motion graphics and visual effects studio, built in pure Rust.

A free, open-source compositor: compositions, layers, keyframes, 308 effects, layer styles, expressions, 3D cameras and lights, and a render queue, native on macOS, Windows and Linux, and in the browser. Young, moving fast, and already usable.


EffectCraft on getartcraft.com · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps


> [!NOTE] > **ArtCraft is a community of artists from all walks of life.** Digital, generative, music, > games — if you make things, you're one of us. **[Come say hi on Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft).**

What it is · Animate · Effects · 3D · Export · Agents · Get started · Status · How it's made · Downloads · The Crafting Apps · License

## What EffectCraft is EffectCraft is for animated titles, motion graphics and compositing work: the kind of thing motion designers and VFX artists need. You build a composition out of layers (solids, shapes, text, footage, other compositions), animate their properties with keyframes, stack effects on them and render the result. The interface feels natural and responsive, with dedicated panels (Project, Composition, Timeline, Layer, Footage, Effect Controls, Tools, Preview, Effects & Presets, Audio, Info, Paragraph, Character, Align, Progress, Render Queue) and standard motion graphics shortcuts, going further in a few places where it matters to us: - **Lottie import and export built in**, so animations can go straight to the web and apps without a plugin. - **A project file you can read.** Projects are versioned JSON (`.ecproj`), so they diff cleanly in version control. - **Everything is scriptable.** Menu actions, timeline edits and property changes are exposed as commands. Engine commands are available through the CLI, JSON control channel and MCP; UI-only commands use the frontend dispatcher and can be invoked through the control channel or an attached MCP bridge. - **No FFmpeg.** Video and audio decoding and encoding are pure Rust: FilmCraft's codecs and EffectCraft's own VP9, AV1, HEVC and Opus encoders. ## Animate The panels, menus and shortcuts follow standard motion design conventions: Project, Composition, Timeline, Effect Controls, Properties, Effects & Presets, Character, Paragraph, Align, Info, Preview, Audio and the Render Queue, docked the way you expect. Drag footage, comps and effects between them: onto the comp viewer, where they land under the pointer, or into the Timeline, between layers and at the time you point to. - **Layers of every kind:** solids, shapes, text, footage, nested compositions, nulls, adjustment layers, cameras and lights; parenting, track mattes, all 38 blend modes, motion blur. - **Keyframes that behave the same:** linear, Bezier, hold, auto and continuous Bezier, roving keys, Easy Ease (F9), Keyframe Velocity and Interpolation dialogs, copy and paste at the current time, and a **Graph Editor** with value and speed graphs and draggable handles. - **Time:** time remapping, time stretch, time-reverse, freeze frame, work area, markers, exact frame-accurate timing at every frame rate including 29.97 drop-frame. - **Shapes and masks:** shape layers with trim paths, repeaters, round corners, offset, zig zag, twist, wiggle, merge paths and gradient strokes; masks drawn with the pen tool, with modes, feather, expansion and vertex editing in the viewer. - **Text:** point and paragraph text with real shaping in any font installed on your machine, the Character and Paragraph panels, and text animators with range selectors. - **Expressions:** JavaScript with the standard motion expressions model (`wiggle`, `loopOut`, `thisComp.layer("…")`, vector maths on arrays), an inline editor and the pick-whip. - **Timeline like you know it:** twirl layers open to Transform, masks, effects and the rest; drag rows to reorder layers; rename with Enter or a double-click; the property shortcuts (A, P, S, R, T, M, F, E, L, U and their double presses AA, PP, SS, RR, TT, MM, FF, EE, LL, UU), Shift to add properties, Alt+Shift+A/P/S/R/T to key the current time, Ctrl+` to twirl selected layers. - **Puppet tools:** Position, Advanced, Bend, Starch and Overlap pins on a mesh built from the layer, real-time pin recording, rotate/scale handles, pins driven by (or carrying) nulls for rigging, and follow-through for hair and cloth.

## Effects 308 built-in effects across its categories, each with its parameter names, order and defaults: blur and sharpen, channel, color correction (Curves, Levels, Hue/Saturation, a full color-grading panel…), distort (Warp, Bulge, Turbulent Displace, Perspective Pin…), generate (Fractal Noise, Gradient Ramp, Stroke, Write-on, Audio Spectrum…), keying, matte, noise and grain, perspective, **simulation** (Particle Emitter 3D, Rainfall, Shatter, Card Dance, Caustics, Wave World…), stylize (Glow, Glass Relief…), **time** (Echo, Posterize Time, Timewarp, Time Displacement…), **audio** (Reverb, Parametric EQ, Delay, Stereo Mixer…), text, transitions, utility and expression controls. All nine **Layer Styles** (Drop Shadow, Inner/Outer Glow, Bevel and Emboss, Satin, overlays, Stroke) with Global Light. Preview plays audio in sync, with meters and waveforms. ## 3D Classic 3D compositing: 3D layers with orientation and material options, one- and two-node **cameras** with depth of field, **lights** (parallel, spot, point, ambient) with soft ray-traced shadows, layers that intersect correctly, orbit, pan and dolly camera tools, and Front, Top, Left and Custom views.

## Export A dedicated Render Queue, with Render Settings and Output Modules: **H.264** MP4 and **ProRes** MOV (Proxy to 4444 XQ with alpha) with audio, **HEVC** (Main / Main 10) and **AV1** MP4, **WebM** (VP9 with inter frames and alpha, or AV1; Opus audio), PNG, JPEG, TIFF, Targa and 32-bit EXR sequences, animated GIF and WAV/AIFF. Field rendering with 3:2 pulldown, effect/solo/guide/depth overrides, crop, region of interest and resize, Render Settings and Output Module templates with defaults, post-render actions, storage overflow and render logs. The same queue runs from the command line. Every encoder is pure Rust (craft-libs' H.264, ProRes, HEVC, VP9, AV1 and AAC; EffectCraft's own Opus); there is no FFmpeg inside. **Lottie** goes both ways: File ▸ Export ▸ Lottie JSON… writes a composition (precomps, shape, solid, image, text and null layers, eased and spatial keyframes, masks, track mattes, blend modes, time remapping, optionally expressions) as `.json` or `.lottie`, and lists anything Lottie cannot express; File ▸ Import ▸ Lottie… opens one as a new composition.

## Built for agents Engine commands are available through the CLI, JSON control channel and MCP. UI-only commands need the running app's frontend dispatcher: complete menu access requires the app's control channel or an attached MCP bridge. Headless MCP sessions expose supported engine commands, but not UI-only commands or bridge-only `ui_*` tools. - **MCP server:** `effectcraft-cli mcp` speaks the Model Context Protocol over stdio, headless or bridged to the running app (`--bridge 9877`). Tools cover commands, the project and property tree, keyframes and rendered frames. This repository ships a ready [`.mcp.json`](.mcp.json). - **Command line:** one-shot calls with JSON output, for example `effectcraft-cli set Main '#1' transform/position '[100,360]' --time 0 main.ecproj --save` or `effectcraft-cli render --comp Main --out main.mp4`, or `effectcraft-cli exec file.exportLottie '{"comp":"Main","path":"main.json"}' main.ecproj`. - **Control channel:** `effectcraft --control 9877` accepts JSON lines to run commands, inspect and click any widget by its automation id, and take screenshots. See [docs/agents.md](docs/agents.md) and [docs/control-protocol.md](docs/control-protocol.md). ## Get started Installers for each version are on the [Releases](https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/releases) page: a universal macOS app; Windows MSIs and portable zips for x64, x86 and ARM64; Linux AppImage, Flatpak, deb, rpm and tar.gz for x86_64 and aarch64, plus a riscv64 tar.gz; a FreeBSD x86_64 tarball; and the web build. [Downloads](#downloads) lists every file. The Windows ARM64 build runs natively on Windows on ARM, without x64 emulation. CI installs that MSI on Windows 11 ARM64 hardware, checks both programs are ARM64 and runs the command-line tool there, but it doesn't open the app's window or run the test suite natively on ARM64 yet, so please report anything that behaves differently. On Gentoo, the community [::snakebyte overlay](https://github.com/switch87/snakebyte-overlay) packages the Linux release as `media-video/effectcraft-bin` (not maintained by the EffectCraft team): ```sh eselect repository add snakebyte git https://github.com/switch87/snakebyte-overlay.git emaint sync -r snakebyte echo 'media-video/effectcraft-bin ~amd64' >> /etc/portage/package.accept_keywords/effectcraft emerge --ask media-video/effectcraft-bin ``` To build it yourself you need [Rust](https://rustup.rs/) 1.95 or newer. ```sh git clone https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft cd effectcraft cargo run --release -p effectcraft # the app (add `-- --demo` to open the demo project) cargo run --release -p effectcraft-cli -- render --out intro.mp4 # render the demo headless cargo xtask web --serve 8765 # the browser build on http://127.0.0.1:8765/ (docs/web.md) ``` New to it? [docs/footage.md](docs/footage.md) covers importing footage and image sequences and Interpret Footage. To work on it: `cargo test --workspace`, and `cargo xtask ci` before every commit (format, lints, tests, layering, asset attribution and the WebAssembly build). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) and [docs/testing.md](docs/testing.md). ## Where it stands EffectCraft is young: its first commit was on 1 October 2026. A comprehensive feature set exists, including 308 effects, but breadth is not the same as full maturity across every edge case. Today it's a good place to try things and to tell us what breaks. It isn't yet recommended for production client work. In particular: - **Native project format.** Projects are saved as `.ecproj`, readable versioned JSON. Proprietary project formats and After Effects SDK plug-ins are not supported. - **Fidelity is still being refined.** Automated rendering tests currently focus on small compositions, so please report visual discrepancies or unexpected behaviour. - **macOS is the most tested platform.** Linux and Windows users have hit basic interaction bugs, which we're fixing first. - **The trained models are new.** Roto Brush can use MobileSAM (an optional 40 MB download in Settings ▸ Roto Brush) and face tracking can use Google's MediaPipe Face Landmarker (an optional 3.8 MB download in Settings ▸ Face Tracking). Both are actively undergoing evaluation and tuning. EffectCraft is in **alpha**: about 91% of the features tracked in [docs/target-app-parity.md](docs/target-app-parity.md) exist, and we estimate it is about 45% of the way to being ready for full professional production work. The [ROADMAP](ROADMAP.md) has the plan, [docs/target-app-parity.md](docs/target-app-parity.md) the measurement and [docs/gaps.md](docs/gaps.md) every known shortfall. The web build ([docs/web.md](docs/web.md)) runs the full app in the browser. [Bug reports](https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/issues) are the most useful thing you can send us right now. ## How it's made - **Engine first.** A stack of small crates with strict layering. The interface (egui) sits on top and nothing underneath depends on it. - **Clean room.** We work from public documentation and observable behavior, never from proprietary files, icons, presets or code. No code is copied from GPL projects. The full rules are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). - **Private by default.** No telemetry, and no network access unless you ask for it. - **One family.** EffectCraft shares its time model and text engine design with FilmCraft, and gets its video and audio codecs from it. ## Downloads **New to EffectCraft?** Download it from the [EffectCraft page on getartcraft.com](https://getartcraft.com/apps/effectcraft). That's the easiest way to install it. **Want a specific build or format?** On GitHub, the [latest release](https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/releases/latest) has every build listed below, and [all releases](https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft/releases) has earlier versions and their notes. `` in the file names is the version number, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists a checksum for every file. ### Windows | Build | Installer | Portable | |---|---|---| | x64 (64-bit Intel/AMD) | `effectcraft--windows-x64.msi` | `effectcraft--windows-x64-portable.zip` | | arm64 (Snapdragon and other ARM PCs) | `effectcraft--windows-arm64.msi` | `effectcraft--windows-arm64-portable.zip` | | x86 (32-bit) | `effectcraft--windows-x86.msi` | `effectcraft--windows-x86-portable.zip` | Installers and executables are code-signed. The installer asks who to install EffectCraft for and where. By default it installs for your account only, into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ArtCraft\EffectCraft`, without an administrator prompt; "Everyone on this computer" installs into `C:\Program Files\ArtCraft\EffectCraft` (`Program Files (x86)` for the 32-bit build). Later versions install into the same folder. To install silently into a folder of your choice: `msiexec /i effectcraft--windows-x64.msi /qn INSTALLFOLDER="D:\Apps\EffectCraft"`. A silent install is per-user by default. `INSTALLFOLDER` chooses the folder, not who it is installed for; add `ALLUSERS=1`, from an elevated terminal or deployment tool, for an all-users install. ### macOS | Build | File | Notes | |---|---|---| | App, universal (Apple silicon + Intel) | `effectcraft--macos-universal.dmg` | Signed and notarized | | Command-line tool, universal | `effectcraft-cli--macos-universal.zip` | Signed and notarized | ### Linux | Format | x86_64 | aarch64 (ARM64) | Notes | |---|---|---|---| | AppImage | `effectcraft--linux-x86_64.AppImage` | `effectcraft--linux-aarch64.AppImage` | Runs anywhere; updates itself with [AppImageUpdate](https://github.com/AppImageCommunity/AppImageUpdate) (`.zsync` files) | | Flatpak | `effectcraft--linux-x86_64.flatpak` | `effectcraft--linux-aarch64.flatpak` | Sandboxed; `flatpak install --user ` | | Debian/Ubuntu | `effectcraft--linux-x86_64.deb` | `effectcraft--linux-aarch64.deb` | | | Fedora/RHEL/openSUSE | `effectcraft--linux-x86_64.rpm` | `effectcraft--linux-aarch64.rpm` | | | Tarball | `effectcraft--linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `effectcraft--linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Unpack anywhere | RISC-V 64-bit: `effectcraft--linux-riscv64.tar.gz` (tarball only; needs glibc 2.39+, e.g. Ubuntu 24.04+ or Debian 13+). **File drag-and-drop on Linux:** The current eframe/winit 0.30 native Wayland backend does not deliver file-hover or file-drop events. On Hyprland and other native Wayland sessions, use **File ▸ Import ▸ File…** (which accepts multiple files), or start EffectCraft via XWayland if XWayland is installed and `DISPLAY` is set: ```sh env -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY effectcraft ``` When the backend delivers events (X11/XWayland, Windows and macOS), dropping media anywhere in the window imports it, and a drop-target hint appears while hovering. On native Wayland the app cannot detect an attempt that generates no event; it shows a startup notice with the File ▸ Import fallback instead. ### FreeBSD | Build | File | |---|---| | x86_64 | `effectcraft--freebsd-x86_64.tar.gz` | ### Web (WebAssembly) | Build | File | Notes | |---|---|---| | Static site | `effectcraft-web-.zip` | Runs in a modern browser; host it on any static server | ##
